title: Imadoki!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tanpopo Yamazaki tests into the elite Meio Academy, where children of wealthy families snub her and look down on students without connections. The boy she saw tending a dandelion ignores her, so she starts a gardening committee to make friends and survive a school ruled by superficiality and money.
life_message: A good life means staying true to yourself and nurturing friendship in a status-obsessed world.
